scene: Laced skates hum vibrantly, rolling you directly onto the transit concourse.
picture: A flat side view along a wide marble transit concourse. On the far left, a glass mountain cable tram waits with open doors. The player stands centre-left wearing glowing neon skates, lilac headscarf, and mustard coat. At centre, a striped garden gondola bobs at a mooring, while a lantern-lit river barge rests on the far right.
